content.text:
Your settings file still has `"isUndetectable": true`, and it hasn't been modified since May 27, so the terminal command from last time never ran. Nothing has changed yet, which is why the window is still black.

I've now made the fix in the code. In `electron/main.ts`, the app ignores that saved setting when it starts and rewrites it to `false`, and it no longer hides its Dock icon at launch. I haven't tested it: there's no `node_modules` in the repo, so I couldn't build or typecheck it.

There's a catch, though. You're running the installed app in `/Applications/Natively.app`, which doesn't include my change. To get it you'd have to run `npm install` and `npm run dist` and reinstall, which is slow and a lot of setup just for this.

The fastest fix is still the settings reset. Paste this into Terminal (not into this chat, since I'm not allowed to change that file):

```
pkill -ix natively; sleep 2; sed -i '' 's/"isUndetectable": true/"isUndetectable": false/' ~/Library/Application\ Support/Natively/settings.json; grep isUndetectable ~/Library/Application\ Support/Natively/settings.json
```

It should print `"isUndetectable": false`. Then open Natively and share your screen again. Tell me once you've run it and I'll check the file to confirm it took.
